schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY SEHAT (Golden Card)
schemes.department: State Health Agency, Health & Medical Education Department, Jammu & Kashmir
schemes.brief: Free health cover of Rs.5 lakh a year for every family living in Jammu & Kashmir, whatever its income, including government employees and pensioners. Treatment is cashless at empanelled government and private hospitals in J&K, and at PM-JAY hospitals across India. The card, called the Golden Card or Ayushman card, is made on the family's ration card, and you can make it yourself on the phone.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, no premium
eligibility: Every family living in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir, with no income limit
The family must hold a J&K ration card; every member named on it is covered
Government employees, pensioners and their families are covered too
Families already in the PM-JAY list get the same Rs.5 lakh card under that list
Everyone aged 70 or above can also get the Ayushman Vay Vandana card
Illnesses you already have are covered from day one, with 3 days of costs before admission and 15 days after
documents: Aadhaar card of each family member
J&K ration card (inner and outer pages), which links the whole family
Mobile number for OTP
Domicile certificate, if the CSC or hospital desk asks for proof of residence
A live photo, taken on the phone during e-KYC

demoFields.label: Login as
demoFields.hint: Choose Beneficiary when you are making the card for yourself or your family, not Operator.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Any working number you hold. The OTP comes here, and so does the message when the card is approved.

demoFields.label: Scheme and state
demoFields.hint: SEHAT runs through PM-JAY, so choose PMJAY and then Jammu and Kashmir.

demoFields.label: Search your family by
demoFields.hint: The ration card number finds everyone in the family at once. You can also search by Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the ration card. If nothing is found, search again with your Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number for e-KYC
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the family member whose card you are making now. Each member is done one at a time.

demoFields.label: e-KYC method
demoFields.hint: Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar; otherwise choose face authentication and scan the face on the phone camera.

demoFields.label: Live photo
demoFields.hint: Good light, face straight, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets the request rejected.

demoFields.label: Relation with head of family
demoFields.hint: How this member is related to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: District and PIN code
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live now, so the nearest empanelled hospitals are shown to you.

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in (or the Ayushman app) and log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP.
Choose PMJAY and the state Jammu and Kashmir, then search for your family by ration card number or Aadhaar.
Find the member marked eKYC pending, verify with Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, and take the live photo.
Fill in the relation, district and PIN code and submit. The State Health Agency usually approves it within a day or two.
Log in again, open Download Card and save the Golden Card. If your family is not found, go to a CSC or the Ayushman Mitra desk of a SEHAT hospital with your ration card and Aadhaar.
At the hospital, show the card at the Ayushman Mitra desk and pay nothing for a covered treatment. If an empanelled hospital refuses, call 104.
schemes.helpline: 104 — J&K health helpline, also for complaints when treatment is refused / 14555 or 1800-111-565 — Ayushman Bharat national helpline

schemes.title: Ladli Beti Scheme, Jammu & Kashmir
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare, Jammu & Kashmir
schemes.brief: For a girl born on or after 1 April 2015 into a low-income family in Jammu & Kashmir, the government puts Rs.1,000 a month into an account in her name until she turns 14. The money then stays in a term deposit, and at 21 she receives about Rs.6.5 lakh for her studies or marriage. Parents apply online on JanSugam (also reached through e-UNNAT); the CDPO checks the application and the Deputy Commissioner sanctions it.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,000 a month till she is 14; about Rs.6.5 lakh paid to her at 21
eligibility: The girl was born on or after 1 April 2015
The parents' total income from all sources is below Rs.75,000 a year
The girl and her parents are residents of Jammu & Kashmir
The money is held in the girl's own account and paid to her only at age 21
documents: Birth certificate of the girl
Income certificate of the parents, showing less than Rs.75,000 a year
Aadhaar card of the girl and of the parents
Domicile certificate of the parents
Ration card or other address proof
J&K Bank account details in the girl's name, once the sanction letter asks for them

demoFields.label: Name of the girl child
demoFields.hint: Exactly as written on her birth certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: Must be on or after 01/04/2015. Apply soon after the birth certificate is issued.

demoFields.label: Place of birth
demoFields.hint: The hospital or place named on the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: Father's name
demoFields.hint: As on his Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Mother's name
demoFields.hint: As on her Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number of parent
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on the mother's or father's own Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Annual family income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Total from all sources, the same figure as on the income certificate. It must be below Rs.75,000.

demoFields.label: District and ICDS project
demoFields.hint: The block ICDS project where you live. Its CDPO checks your form.

demoFields.label: Address
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Application updates and the sanction message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on jansugam.jk.gov.in (or open it from e-UNNAT) with your mobile number, then log in.
Under Social Welfare, choose Application for obtaining Financial Assistance under Ladli Beti Scheme and fill in the girl's and parents' details.
Upload the birth, income and domicile certificates and the Aadhaar cards, submit, and note the application number from the SMS.
The CDPO checks the form within 15 days, then the District Programme Officer and the Deputy Commissioner take it up; the whole process is meant to finish within 45 days.
After sanction, open the girl's account at J&K Bank if the sanction letter asks, and add the account number on the portal.
Rs.1,000 is credited every month until she turns 14. At 21 the matured amount, about Rs.6.5 lakh, is paid to her.
schemes.helpline: 0194-2479645 — Directorate of Social Welfare, Kashmir / your District Social Welfare Officer or CDPO (ICDS) office

schemes.title: Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana (DDSSY Card)
schemes.department: Directorate of Health Services, Government of Goa
schemes.brief: Goa's own health insurance for almost every family that has lived in the state for five years or more. Since July 2026 it pays up to Rs.4 lakh a year for a family of up to three, and Rs.6 lakh for a family of four or more, cashless at empanelled government and private hospitals. You pay only a small registration fee, and the card must be renewed every policy year (1 April to 31 March) on Goa Online.
schemes.benefit: Rs.4 lakh a year (up to 3 members) or Rs.6 lakh (4 or more), cashless
eligibility: Anyone who has lived in Goa for five years or more, together with their family
Family means spouse, unmarried children and dependent parents (or parents-in-law if the eligible person is a woman); one family cannot be split across two cards
There is no income limit
Central and State government employees covered by government medical reimbursement are not eligible
Fee: Rs.200 for 3 or fewer members, Rs.300 for 4 or more; OBC (non-creamy layer), SC, ST and differently abled families pay half
documents: Aadhaar card (or enrolment slip) of every family member above 5 years
Residence proof of the eligible person issued at least 5 years ago in Goa: passport, residence certificate, voter ID, driving licence or Aadhaar, with the issue date visible
Ration card, to show who is in the family
Without a ration card: marriage certificate for the spouse, birth or school leaving certificate for children, and a declaration that the parents are not employed
Birth certificate for a minor who has no Aadhaar
For the fee concession: caste certificate (with income certificate below Rs.6 lakh for OBC) or disability certificate

demoFields.label: Eligible person (head of family)
demoFields.hint: The family member whose 5-year Goa residence proof you will attach. Name as on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on the eligible person's own Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Approval and card messages come here by SMS.

demoFields.label: Residence proof
demoFields.hint: Must have been issued in Goa at least 5 years ago, and the issue date must be visible on the scan.

demoFields.label: Family member 1
demoFields.hint: Name, relation and Aadhaar of each member. Add every member; a family cannot be split.

demoFields.label: Family member 2
demoFields.hint: For a child under 5 without Aadhaar, attach the birth certificate instead.

demoFields.label: Family member 3
demoFields.hint: A woman eligible person can add dependent parents-in-law. Four members means Rs.6 lakh cover and a Rs.300 fee.

demoFields.label: Concession category
demoFields.hint: Choose OBC (non-creamy layer), SC, ST or differently abled only if you upload the certificate; the fee is then halved.

demoFields.label: Office to collect the card
demoFields.hint: Pick the health office nearest your home. Collect the card there within 30 days of approval.

demoSteps: Register on goaonline.gov.in with your mobile OTP and log in. Open Services, All Services, then Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana (DDSSY) - New Enrollment.
Fill in the eligible person's details, add each family member with Aadhaar, and upload the self-attested 5-year residence proof.
Choose a concession category if you have one, pay the fee (Rs.200 for up to 3 members, Rs.300 for 4 or more) and note the acknowledgement number.
If the application is marked for compliance, reply within 30 days, or it is rejected and the fee is forfeited.
When the SMS says it is approved, download the e-card and collect the DDSSY card from the office you chose within 30 days.
Show the card at the DDSSY desk of an empanelled hospital for cashless treatment. Renew it every year before 31 March through DDSSY - Renewal, using the card number and OTP.
schemes.helpline: 8882988000 — Goa Online helpline for DDSSY enrolment and renewal (9:45 am to 5:30 pm) / 0832-2225561 — Directorate of Health Services, Panaji

schemes.title: Griha Aadhar (Homemaker Allowance)
schemes.department: Directorate of Women & Child Development, Government of Goa
schemes.brief: Rs.1,500 every month in the bank account of a Goan homemaker whose family earns up to Rs.3 lakh a year, to help with household costs. It is for married women, widows and divorcees who have lived in Goa for 15 years. Apply on Goa Online; the money arrives by the 10th of each month. The 2026-27 budget announced an increase, but the new amount had not been notified when this was checked.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,500 a month, credited by the 10th
eligibility: Married woman, widow or divorcee aged 18 or above
Resident of Goa for at least 15 years; if she was born outside Goa, the husband's 15-year residence is checked too
Combined gross income of wife and husband not above Rs.3 lakh a year
Not for women who are, or whose husbands are, regular government or listed public-sector employees
Cannot be drawn together with the Dayanand Social Security pension, except by some widows with young children
documents: Birth certificate of the applicant
Marriage certificate (husband's death certificate for a widow, divorce order for a divorcee)
Residence certificate showing 15 years in Goa (husband's birth and residence certificates if you were born outside Goa)
Voter ID or Aadhaar card
Income proof, with the self-declaration of occupation and income
Savings bank account details, with the account linked to Aadhaar
Photo and signature of the applicant
Verification report signed by a Gazetted Officer, MLA or MP (format on the Goa Online page)

demoFields.label: Eligibility questions
demoFields.value: Married / 15+ years in Goa / income below Rs.3 lakh / husband not in government service
demoFields.hint: Answer honestly. The form opens only if every answer fits the rules.

demoFields.label: Applicant name
demoFields.hint: As on your Aadhaar and bank passbook, so the money is not held up.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: As on your birth certificate.

demoFields.label: Marital status
demoFields.hint: Married, widow or divorcee. Widows and divorcees upload the death certificate or divorce order.

demoFields.label: Husband's name
demoFields.hint: As on the marriage certificate.

demoFields.label: Taluka and village
demoFields.hint: Where you live now; the field check is done here.

demoFields.label: Combined annual income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Your income and your husband's together, before deductions. It must not be above Rs.3,00,000.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Your own 12-digit Aadhaar. The bank account must be linked to it or payment is stopped.

demoFields.label: Bank account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: A savings account in your own name. Copy the IFSC from the passbook.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The acknowledgement and sanction messages come here.

demoSteps: Register on goaonline.gov.in with your mobile OTP and log in.
Open Services, All Services, Directorate of Women & Child Development, Griha Aadhar Scheme, and answer the eligibility questions.
Fill in the form and upload the documents, including the verification report signed by a Gazetted Officer, MLA or MP.
Save, pay the fee shown, and note the acknowledgement number sent by SMS and email.
The Directorate checks the application and may verify it at your home; you then get a sanction order.
Rs.1,500 is credited by the 10th of every month. Give a life certificate and income certificate between 1 April and 30 May each year, or the payment stops.
schemes.helpline: 9284238500 — Griha Aadhar queries, Directorate of Women & Child Development / 8882988000 — Goa Online helpline

schemes.title: Dayanand Social Security Scheme (DSSS Pension)
schemes.department: Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa
schemes.brief: Goa's monthly pension for senior citizens, widows, single women, persons with disabilities and people living with HIV/AIDS, from families earning up to Rs.1.5 lakh a year. It pays Rs.2,000 to Rs.4,000 a month straight into the bank account, by the 10th of each month. The form is handed in at the Directorate of Social Welfare in Panaji or the District Welfare Office in Margao. An increase of at least Rs.500 a month was proposed in 2026 but had not been notified when this was checked.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,000 a month; Rs.2,500 for widows and single women; up to Rs.4,000
eligibility: Senior citizen aged 60 or above on the day of applying
Widow aged 18 or above (Rs.4,000 if her youngest child is under 21); divorced, deserted or separated woman aged 18 or above; unmarried woman above 50
Person with a disability under the RPwD Act 2016 (Rs.2,500 for a child, Rs.3,500 for 90–100% disability), or a person living with HIV/AIDS
Resident of Goa by birth, or by domicile of 15 years
Annual family income not above Rs.1.5 lakh
A Griha Aadhar holder must sign an undertaking to cancel Griha Aadhar once DSSS is sanctioned
documents: Birth certificate or other age proof notified by the government
15-year residence certificate
Income certificate, or a self-declaration on Rs.50 stamp paper in the set format
Verification certificate
Aadhaar card and bank passbook copy
Disability certificate (persons with disability); spouse's death certificate and marriage certificate (widows)
Self-declaration on Rs.50 stamp paper (unmarried single women); legal guardianship certificate (intellectual disability or autism)
schemes.submitAt: Directorate of Social Welfare, 18th June Road, opposite Salcete Pharmacy, Panaji (North Goa, 0832-2232257), or the District Welfare Office, Mathany Saldanha Administrative Complex, Ground Floor, Block 21, Margao (South Goa, 0832-2794021). Ask for the DSSS form at the counter, attach self-attested copies of the documents, carry the originals for checking, pay the Rs.200 registration fee and keep the receipt.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: Senior citizen, single woman, widow, person with disability or HIV/AIDS. Tick only one.

demoFields.label: Full name
demoFields.hint: As on your Aadhaar and bank passbook.

demoFields.label: Date of birth and age
demoFields.hint: As on your birth certificate or other age proof. Seniors must be 60 on the day of applying.

demoFields.label: Address and constituency
demoFields.hint: Your full address in Goa and your assembly constituency.

demoFields.label: Residence in Goa
demoFields.hint: Born in Goa, or living here for at least 15 years, shown by the residence certificate.

demoFields.label: Annual family income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Total family income from all sources. It must not be above Rs.1,50,000.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Your own 12-digit Aadhaar; the bank account should be linked to it.

demoFields.label: Bank account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: A savings account in your own name. The pension is paid only here.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: So the department can call you about the field check or sanction.

demoSteps: Get the income certificate (or the Rs.50 stamp-paper declaration) and the 15-year residence certificate ready, then collect the DSSS form at the Directorate in Panaji or the District Welfare Office in Margao.
Fill in the form, attach self-attested copies, and get the verification certificate signed.
Submit it with the Rs.200 registration fee and keep the receipt. If the scheme's limit is full, you are put on a waiting list, first come, first served.
The department checks your papers and issues a sanction order with your DSS sanction number.
The pension is credited to your bank account by the 10th of every month.

Every year between 1 April and 30 May, give a life certificate (signed before a Gazetted Officer, MLA, MP, Sarpanch, municipal chairperson or bank manager) and an income certificate, or the pension stops.
schemes.helpline: 8882988000 — Dayanand Social Security Scheme helpline / 0832-2232257 — Directorate of Social Welfare, Panaji / 0832-2794021 — District Welfare Office, Margao

schemes.title: Ladakh Universal Health Care Scheme (Golden Card)
schemes.department: Health & Medical Education Department, UT Ladakh
schemes.brief: Ladakh's own free health insurance, started in December 2020 alongside Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY so that families left out of the PM-JAY list are covered too. Every ration card household gets a Golden Card worth Rs.5 lakh a year for hospital treatment, tests and medicines, cashless at empanelled hospitals. The card is made at the Ayushman desk of a government hospital, at an enrolment camp or at a CSC, using the ration card and Aadhaar.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh a year per household, cashless and free
eligibility: Every family in UT Ladakh that holds a ration card
Families already in the PM-JAY list get the PM-JAY card; all others are covered by the UT's own scheme
No income limit and no premium
Newborn babies can be given a Golden Card at birth in the hospital
If your family is missing from the list or a name is wrong, apply first at the Tehsildar's office
documents: Ladakh ration card
Aadhaar card of each family member
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar, for the OTP
Birth certificate for a newborn or a child without Aadhaar
For inclusion or name correction: a written application at the Tehsildar's office with copies of the ration card and Aadhaar
schemes.submitAt: The Ayushman (PM-JAY) desk at SNM Hospital Leh, District Hospital Kargil or your nearest Community Health Centre, or a Common Service Centre or Golden Card camp in your block. Take the ration card, every member's Aadhaar card and the mobile phone linked to Aadhaar; each member to be enrolled should come along for the fingerprint, OTP or photo. If your family is not found or a name is wrong, first give an application with the same documents at your Tehsildar's office.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: The operator finds your family with this number. Bring the card itself, not just a photo of it.

demoFields.label: Head of family
demoFields.hint: The person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: Member being enrolled
demoFields.hint: Each member gets a card; they are done one by one.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on this member's own Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Verification method
demoFields.hint: OTP goes to the mobile linked to Aadhaar. If none is linked, fingerprint or face scan is used at the desk.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The approval message comes here.

demoFields.label: Relation with head of family
demoFields.hint: How this member is related to the head of the family on the ration card.

demoFields.label: District and tehsil
demoFields.hint: Where you live now.

demoFields.label: Photo
demoFields.hint: Face straight, no cap or dark glasses.

demoSteps: Take the ration card, every member's Aadhaar and the Aadhaar-linked mobile to the Ayushman desk at SNM Hospital Leh, DH Kargil, a CHC, a CSC or a Golden Card camp.
The operator searches your family by ration card or Aadhaar and verifies each member by Aadhaar OTP, fingerprint or face.
A photo is taken and the card request is sent for approval.
Once approved, the Golden Card is printed or given to you to download; you can also keep it on the Ayushman app.
If your family was not found, apply at the Tehsildar's office for inclusion, then go back to the desk to enrol.
At an empanelled hospital, show the card at the Ayushman desk and pay nothing for a covered treatment.
schemes.helpline: 14555 or 1800-111-565 — Ayushman Bharat helpline / 01982-257561 — Health & Medical Education Department, UT Ladakh
